title: Privilege & Entitlement Changes
description: Grant, revoke, and role changes requiring review.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Data Safe Database Audit' and 'Operation' in ('GRANT','REVOKE','CREATE ROLE','ALTER ROLE','DROP ROLE') | stats count as 'Changes' by 'Data Safe Target Name', 'Database User', 'Operation' | sort -'Changes'
